chassis.status: Original width/height retained; extended depth is a proposal. No rack-ear load claim.

dimension_evidence.policy: Use larger published width for the concept envelope; resolve physical dimensions before mounting geometry.

board.datum_status: PROVISIONAL: origin is a layout choice. No measured mounting-hole, I/O-shield or slot-to-outline datums.

front_component_reservation.status: PROVISIONAL PCH/front-component reservation; replace with measured components

board.purchase_status: NOT ORDERED; no physical board measurements available

gpus.status: 40.64 pitch is nominal dual-slot spacing. First plane, body-to-slot offsets and all GPU envelopes are provisional; different active/passive housings require measurement.

nvlink.status: Oversized planning reservations, NOT measured bridge solids or proof of bridge fit

blower_air_reservation.status: PROVISIONAL side intake/service region; actual blower inlet must be measured

cpu_coolers.status: PROVISIONAL cooler envelopes and approximate socket centers; target requires narrow-ILM LGA2011-3 coolers, model not selected

psus.status: NO PSU SELECTED. Default160mm body plus30mm cable reservation; profile140/150/160/180/200mm bodies and30/50mm cable zones. No electrical load-sharing claim.

fans.status: R02 three dedicated120mm fans, one per passive GPU. L bank: slot8 upper-left, slot6 lower-left, slot4 lower-right. Equal fan face area is not equal airflow.

ducts.status: Three closed concept shells with open ends. Mouths are rectangular reservations, not final RTX 8000 interfaces. No print-overhang, thermal or physical-fit validation.

printer.status: Conservative body cap220x220x240; actual centered placement plus5mm brim and cutter exclusion checked. Slicer must still verify supports, purge/flow-calibration regions and toolpaths.

required_measurements: Resolve motherboard width disagreement and measure all 14 mounting holes relative to a defined PCB datum
Measure rear I/O shield plane and all four GPU slot planes relative to PCB edges
Measure each passive and blower GPU housing, bracket tabs/flanges and power-connector plug/bend envelopes
Measure both existing NVLink bridges and their installed height and position
Select narrow-ILM LGA2011-3 CPU coolers and record full envelope, airflow and fastener access
Select both PSUs; record depth, modular-connector positions and cable bend/plug envelopes
Measure motherboard DIMMs, VRMs, PCH and auxiliary-power plugs beneath the proposed ducts
Design duct supports forward of PCB; original Y350 floor anchors are covered by this board layout
Resolve original rear-bracket clearance and PSU screw-seat issues through physical fit checks
Print and measure split-duct socket/spigot fit, collar closure and M3 fastener stack; axial retention is friction only
Select fan models and measure actual heatsink pressure drop, per-card airflow and GPU temperatures; equal area is not equal airflow
Verify Bambu Studio plate placement, brim, supports, travel/cutter and flow-calibration regions before printing
